## Ringkasan

Runtime Python EOD: scheduler retry (eod_retry_scheduler, :8091) memindai file DMAA / ITM, menjadwalkan retry, dan mencatat audit. Halaman Monitoring EOD (ADMIN / ADMIN_PARAM) menampilkan status file, ringkasan, telat, dan retry. Belum ada eod_runs dan hitung Final Realisasi (Phase 7).

## Peran (role)

Menu sidebar CompanyPortal (`navigation.ts`):

- **EOD Monitoring** `/eod-monitoring`: ADMIN, ADMIN_PARAM

Route frontend:

- `/eod-monitoring`: ADMIN, ADMIN_PARAM ([`eod-monitoring.tsx`](../../frontend/CompanyPortal-Vite/src/routes/eod-monitoring.tsx))
